Description - GET /resume/check/

Before resuming an interrupted upload the client asks the upload server how many bytes are stored for the ticket key (flags :noRelog, :sessionBound). The server is the forced file server (--file-server <host>, start-up switch or pipe command; C-08) or the UploadToken server. Headers: the Qt 4.8.5 defaults (Inferred, see "SOAP wire format").

Client logic: res=1 and 0 < file_size <= local size: resume with resume_from=file_size (thumbnails only if skipThumbnails="false"); file_size > local size: restart with a new UploadToken; res=-4: network error; other errors: new UploadToken. Live: res=-31 before any byte is stored and for unknown keys.

Responses - 200, 4XX

200

Resume state (XML in a text/html; charset=utf-8 response).

Schema text/html

Schema ResumeCheckReply, as an XML element tree in wire order. Namespaces are shown where they change.

  • <resp> object required ResumeCheckReply no namespace

    Reply of GET /resume/check/. Served as text/html; charset=utf-8.

    • @file_size integer (int64) optional

      Bytes already stored for this key. If 0 < file_size <= local size the client resumes with resume_from=file_size; if larger it restarts with a new UploadToken.

    • @skipThumbnails string optional one of "true", "false"

      Thumbnails already exist; the client generates them on resume only when this is false.

    • @res integer required

      1 = partial/complete data exists; -31 = nothing stored for this key (also for unknown keys); the client treats -4 as a network error and other non-1 values as "request a new UploadToken".

    • @errorMessage string optional

      Error text (read by the client; not observed).

4XX

Not observed live. Client behaviour: HTTP status >= 400 is a server error (code 1), which leads to a new UploadToken.

Client vs live - discrepancies

Where the client's expected behaviour and the live service disagree, the spec follows the live behaviour (x-discrepancies):

  • The client handles only res=-4 (network error); the observed "nothing stored" code is -31.

Security notes - findings that concern GET /resume/check/

  • C-08 Low The single-instance named pipe and the chomik:// scheme accept commands (-d<url>, -u, -p) from any local process or web link. The pipe also accepts --file-server <host>, which redirects all uploads and resume checks, upload keys included, to that host (command Observed; effect Inferred, the link to the upload path was not fully confirmed).

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
